name: Still life
description: Fruit, flowers and laid tables from four centuries of painting, drawing and printmaking, from bright Impressionist tables to quieter Dutch and Spanish still lifes.

works.alt_text: A white jug crowded with blue-violet irises and long green leaves against a pale off-white wall, on a green table.
Peppers, lemons, tomatoes, an aubergine and pomegranates heaped on and around a blue and white dish on a white cloth.
A woodblock print of white and coral pink peonies in a long woven basket, with a poem in flowing calligraphy above.
Green and red apples and a basket of purple and green grapes on a white tablecloth with pale blue shadows.
A woven basket of peaches, plums, cherries and grapes beside a bundle of white asparagus on a wooden ledge.
A tilted basket of apples, a dark bottle, a plate of biscuits and loose fruit on a white cloth on a wooden table.
A watercolour of small birds, including goldfinches and a bee-eater, among pears, plums, a peach and a fig on a grey ground.
A woven basket heaped with ripe red strawberries on a pale table against a grey wall.
A table with a white cloth set with a glass jug, wine glass, teacup, silver pot and a bowl of fruit, with a flowering rhododendron in front.
A round woven bamboo basket holding green leaves and a small white flower, printed on cream paper.
A tall glass jar of strawberries, a bowl of nuts, an orange, a china sugar bowl and a white cream jug on a wooden ledge.
A table draped in patterned cloth with a glass dish of fruit, a white jar, a jug of red and orange zinnias and scattered peaches.
Peaches, a cantaloupe, a pear, grapes and raspberries with a wine glass and a fruit knife on a fringed white cloth.
A garland of roses, tulips and other flowers in a dark niche, partly hidden by a blue silk curtain hanging from a brass rod.
A modern still life of a brown bottle and a large white bowl holding a plum, small lemons and a green pepper on a dark cloth, with a knife.
Peaches, plums, grapes with vine leaves, a halved apple and a glass of wine beside a decanter on a marble ledge.
A small table covered with a white cloth, set with bread, a glass of red wine, a knife and a plate of sliced sausage, beside a wooden wine cooler.
A loose bouquet of cream, pink and deep red roses in a green vase, painted with soft brushstrokes on a warm ground.
A drawing of a copper cooking pot with its lid and a ladle, a cloth hanging over its side and two root vegetables beside it.
Blocks of nougat and candied fruit, a glass flask and a tall goblet on boxes and dishes on a grey stone ledge.
Two red poppies and a few white daisies in a dark round jug against a deep green background.
A watercolour of peaches and blue-violet plums with leafy stems arranged on a grey marble slab, on an oval of cream paper.
A white porcelain bowl of pears and apples surrounded by roses, carnations, jasmine and lilies on a stone ledge against a dark background.
A bunch of white asparagus tied with string, loose spears on a plate and a green glass jug in a dim kitchen.
